name: mint-town-demo-film
description: Three-minute AI Builder Cup film: a dramatized scam, a recorded Gemini investigation, and the next payment protected

scripts.score: uv run --project tools --with numpy python tools/score_v2.py
scripts.story: npm run voice && npm run check && npm run render
scripts.prerender: npm run check:audio && npm run polish:sfx
scripts.postrender: uv run --project tools --locked python tools/verify_video.py --story-v2 --film out/mint-town-story-v2.mp4 --master
scripts.setup:media: uv run --project tools --locked python tools/prepare_assets.py && npm run score && npm run polish:sfx && npm run voice
scripts.prerender:youtube: npm run check:audio && npm run check
scripts.postrender:youtube: uv run --project tools --locked python tools/verify_video.py --story-v2 --film out/resolution-agent-youtube-4k.mp4 --width 3840 --height 2160 --master
